vi: Phân biệt Security Group stateful (gắn instance, allow-only, tự động trả về) và Network ACL stateless (gắn subnet, allow+deny, cần ephemeral port).
Tham chiếu Security Group-to-Security Group (referenced_security_group_id) để cho phép theo identity thay vì CIDR, sống qua auto-scaling.
Viết rule NACL đúng với rule_number ascending, first-match-wins, đặt rule deny dải xấu ở số nhỏ hơn rule allow.
Quản lý cổng ephemeral (1024-65535) trong NACL egress để traffic trả về không bị drop do stateless.
Chặn IP xấu tường minh bằng NACL deny rule, không thể dùng Security Group vì nó chỉ có allow.
en: Distinguish Security Group (stateful, attached to instance, allow-only, automatic return) from Network ACL (stateless, attached to subnet, allow+deny, requires ephemeral ports).
Use Security Group-to-Security Group references (referenced_security_group_id) to allow by identity rather than CIDR, surviving auto-scaling.
Write correct NACL rules with ascending rule_number, first-match-wins, placing deny rules for bad IP ranges at lower numbers than allow rules.
Manage ephemeral ports (1024-65535) in NACL egress to prevent return traffic from being dropped due to statelessness.
Block bad IPs explicitly using NACL deny rules, which cannot be achieved with Security Groups since they only support allow.
